description: Robopocket 2.0 Pro detector-space ROI marker line angle to physical gripper width. ROI endpoints come from the 0529_test episode_0000/episode_0001 observed full open/close angle range using the packaged detector pipeline; the right open endpoint uses the high-percentile open cluster instead of the absolute-max outlier so the observed right peak maps close to physical max. Affine is identity so endpoint calibration owns the current physical min/max mapping.

affine_width_norm_correction.source: identity affine after 0529 lab/pro full-open/full-close endpoint refresh; right open endpoint uses a 104.5 deg high-percentile endpoint to avoid an absolute-max open-angle outlier suppressing the observed peak
affine_width_norm_correction.raw_width_role: local sanity baseline only, not absolute global truth

left.fit_note: identity baseline; observed endpoint extremes provide min/max calibration

right.fit_note: identity baseline; observed endpoint extremes provide min/max calibration
